lines.text:
Hi! Remember me?
I’m one of Professor Oak’s assistants.\c
The professor told me that if your Pokédex has
good data on 50 species of Pokémon, I’m to
give you this [VAR COLOR(0006)]wonderful item[VAR COLOR(0000)].\c
So, [VAR TRNAME(0000)], let me ask you...\c
Have you gathered data on at least 50 species
of Pokémon?

Great!
You have caught [VAR NUM3(0004)] species of Pokémon!\c
Congratulations!
Here, take this wonderful item!
...Oh, I don’t have it!\nD-d-did I lose it?!
Ah, so sorry. What shall I do...?\nI don’t have anything I can give you...\r\nI know!
You got an [VAR COLOR(0006)]Assistant Set[VAR COLOR(0000)] from\nProfessor Oak’s assistant!
You put the [VAR COLOR(0006)]Assistant Set[VAR COLOR(0000)] in your Clothing Trunk!

I made adjustments on my lab coat for you
and your Pokémon.\c
My precious lab coat...
Please wear it with care.
Now I look like an ordinary person, but please\nremember that I’m an assistant to Professor Oak.

Let’s see...
Uh-oh! You’ve only caught [VAR NUM3(0004)] species
of Pokémon!\c
You’ve got to reach 50 species if you want
this [VAR COLOR(0006)]wonderful item[VAR COLOR(0000)] from me.
...Oh. I see.\c\nWhen you get 50 species of Pokémon, come\nback for this [VAR COLOR(0006)]wonderful item[VAR COLOR(0000)].
